acceptanceCriteria: A bounded summary retains immutable repository/result identities, authority, freshness, explicit uncertainty and every critical omission; truncation reports totals and an exact continuation route.

An explicitly selected evidence handle expands only to the matching immutable source bytes with a source digest; invalid, stale, missing and ambiguous handles fail visibly without substituting current content.
Existing source-view promotion blockers, including ESV-V0-005 native source digest, are resolved with recorded evidence; current query wire stays compatible through an additive opt-in consumer.

Freeze a matched complete-task trial against current packets, holding model, effort, framing and cache policy fixed. Measure retrieval plus follow-up reads, correctness, missed evidence, reviewer adequacy and total cost; record unknown telemetry and losing cases. Accept default promotion only after required human acceptance and the owning evaluation passes.

Verify complete source expansion, byte/result bounds and read-only behavior, including hostile handles. Document rollback to current packets; a failed trial remains experimental and does not satisfy the release delivery claim.
body: Owner requested all five n8n-inspired improvements as part of Corvint 0.7.0 on 2026-09-22. Original Go implementations of the patterns; no n8n source import. Extend the cited existing mechanisms. This ticket records release intent, not delivery or promotion. Before implementation is called complete, update the owning indexed spec with stable requirements, non-goals, failure modes, acceptance evidence and rollback, and finish normal CEM/OCM, independent review and mandatory gates. Build on docs/specs/experimental-source-views-v0.md and docs/specs/task-context-packet-v0.md; preserve existing public query wire. Prior art: https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/master/packages/%40n8n/instance-ai/docs/tools.md (summary, debug and bounded node output).
title: Deliver compact evidence summaries with exact drill-down
